title: ROADMAP-1: QNFO.REACH #7: standards wave STD-4 to STD-14, click-first
body:
code-task: repo=ultrastable path=seed/worker/src/auth/oauth.js
code-anchor: export

**Owner:** product-manager
**Program:** QNFO.REACH
**Metric it should move:** readers, owner_load
**Cost rule:** adds no worker, cron or paid model call.
**Done check:** grep:seed/standards/standards.json::STD-14 ; each STD item in seed/standards/standards.json moves from planned to supported with a passing test; python3 -m foundation standards --check
**Status:** open

STD-4..STD-14 researched 2026-11-14 (see docs/standards/AGENTIC-STANDARDS.md): ID-JAG/EMA, device grant and URL elicitation, SSF/CAEP revocation, DPoP/RAR, WIMSE/SPIFFE, AuthZEN, A2A v1.0 signed cards, MCP Apps/AG-UI, ACP, AP2/UCP (gated), C2PA, ISO 42001. Order by click-reduction first: STD-5, STD-4, STD-10, then revocation STD-6, DPoP STD-7.
